title: Statutory Appeal to Insurance Ombudsman & Principal Grievance Officer
content:
BEFORE THE HON'BLE INSURANCE OMBUDSMAN

IN THE MATTER OF: Arbitrary Repudiation of Cataract Surgery Claim
Policy No: SH-2024-998124
Insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.

1. FACTUAL BACKGROUND:
The Complainant holds continuous Health Policy SH-2024-998124 since October 2023 without any break in coverage. On May 14, 2026, the Complainant underwent bilateral cataract surgery at Max Healthcare.

2. GROUNDS OF APPEAL:
A. Violation of IRDAI Master Circular 2024: Waiting period cannot exceed 36 months of continuous coverage.
B. Incontestability under Section 45: Policy completed over 3 continuous policy years.
C. Treating Physician Certification confirms acute clinical necessity.

3. PRAYER:
Direct Insurer to disburse Rs 1,45,000 along with statutory 9% p.a. penal interest.

title: Complaint to Banking Ombudsman for Turnaround Breach & Statutory Delay Compensation
content:
BEFORE THE BANKING OMBUDSMAN (RESERVE BANK OF INDIA)

COMPLAINT UNDER RBI INTEGRATED OMBUDSMAN SCHEME 2021

1. Dispute relates to unreversed duplicate UPI transaction of Rs 5,000 on 02-Jun-2026.
2. Merchant settlement certificate proves single receipt.
3. Bank failed to comply with RBI circular on customer compensation for failed transactions.

RELIEF SOUGHT: Immediate reversal of Rs 5,000 plus Rs 1,200 delay compensation (Rs 100/day).

title: Demand Notice & AirSewa Grievance under DGCA CAR Section 3
content:
TO: APPELLATE AUTHORITY, INTERGLOBE AVIATION LTD & DGCA AIRSEWA

SUBJECT: Demand for Statutory Passenger Compensation for Cancellation of Flight 6E-241

1. Flight cancelled without statutory 24-hour advance notice.
2. Passenger was forced to accept voucher against explicit verbal and written refusal.
3. Claiming full ticket refund of Rs 8,450 + Rs 10,000 mandatory compensation under DGCA CAR Section 3.

title: Appellate Grievance to Airtel Appellate Authority & TRAI PG Portal
content:
TO THE APPELLATE AUTHORITY, BHARTI AIRTEL LTD

REGARDING: Unlawful Post-Termination Billing for Connection No. 9811449182

1. Service was formally surrendered and acknowledged on April 4, 2026.
2. Subsequent bills dated May 1 and June 1 are void ab initio.
3. Demand immediate billing cancellation and written confirmation of zero liability.
